title: Pure Lightray
summary: A Lightsworn-powered Lightray beatdown and control strategy. The Lightsworn milling core stocks the Graveyard with LIGHT monsters and banishes resources to meet the summon conditions of high-Level Lightray bosses.

summary.title: Starters & Milling Engine
points: Charge of the Light Brigade: Mills three cards from the top of the Deck as cost and searches Raiden or Lumina, loading the GY immediately.
Solar Recharge: Discards a Lightsworn monster to draw two cards and mill two cards, accelerating through the deck while setting up GY names.
Raiden, Hand of the Lightsworn: Level 4 Tuner that mills two cards during the Main Phase and two more during the End Phase.
Lumina, Lightsworn Summoner: Discards a card to revive Raiden from the GY, generating materials for Synchro or Xyz plays.
Lightray Grepher: Discards a Level 5 or higher LIGHT monster to Special Summon itself, and discards another LIGHT monster to banish a LIGHT monster directly from the Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Lightsworn Mill into Lightray Flood
steps: Activate Charge of the Light Brigade, milling three cards to search Raiden, Hand of the Lightsworn.
Normal Summon Raiden and activate its effect to mill two more cards, triggering milled copies of Wulf, Lightsworn Beast or Felis, Lightsworn Archer to Special Summon themselves.
Overlay Raiden and Wulf into Minerva, the Exalted Lightsworn, detaching a material to mill three cards and draw for any Lightsworn monsters milled.
With four to five different LIGHT monsters now in the GY, Special Summon Lightray Diabolos and Lightray Daedalus directly from your hand without tributing.
Tune remaining monsters or summon Lightray Sorcerer once three LIGHT monsters have been banished to continue clearing opposing threats.

summary.title: Bosses & Removal
points: Lightray Diabolos: 2800 ATK dragon that summons itself when you have five or more LIGHT monsters with different names in the GY, banishing a LIGHT monster from GY to spin an opponent's Set card to the top or bottom of the Deck.
Lightray Daedalus: 2600 ATK sea serpent that summons itself with four or more LIGHT monsters in the GY, targeting a Field Spell and two other cards on the field to destroy them.
Lightray Sorcerer: Summons itself when three or more LIGHT monsters are banished, shuffling a banished LIGHT monster into the Deck to banish a face-up monster on the field.
Lightray Gearfried: 2800 ATK warrior that summons itself with five different LIGHT monsters in the GY and negates Spell/Trap activations while you control only Warrior monsters.

summary.title: Extra Deck Payoffs
points: Minerva, the Exalted Lightsworn: Rank 4 Xyz that fuels GY setup and card draw on detach, and mills three cards plus destroys up to three opponent cards when destroyed.
Michael, the Arch-Lightsworn: Level 7 Synchro summoned with Raiden and Lumina that pays 1000 LP to banish any card on the field.
Chaos Angel: High-Level Synchro summoned using LIGHT monsters to banish a card on summon and provide protection to your board.
Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy: Rank 8 Dragon Xyz overlaid using two copies of Lightray Gearfried for Spell negation.

main: Lightray Diabolos

Signature Level 7 LIGHT Dragon boss (2800 ATK): Special Summons itself from your hand when you have 5 or more LIGHT monsters with different names in your GY; once per turn, banishes 1 LIGHT monster from your GY to reveal 1 Set card your opponent controls and place it on the top or bottom of their Deck!
Lightray Daedalus

Signature Level 7 LIGHT Sea Serpent boss (2600 ATK): Special Summons itself from your hand when you have 4 or more LIGHT monsters in your GY; once per turn targets 1 Field Spell and 2 other cards on the field and destroys them.
Lightray Sorcerer

Level 6 LIGHT Spellcaster boss (2300 ATK): Special Summons itself from your hand while 3 or more of your LIGHT monsters are banished; shuffles 1 banished LIGHT monster into the Deck to target and banish 1 face-up monster on the field!
Lightray Gearfried

Level 8 LIGHT Warrior boss (2800 ATK): Special Summons itself from your hand when you have 5 or more LIGHT monsters with different names in your GY, and negates Spell/Trap activations while all monsters you control are Warriors.
Lightray Grepher
Level 4 LIGHT Warrior starter: discards 1 Level 5 or higher LIGHT monster to Special Summon itself from hand, and discards 1 LIGHT monster to banish 1 LIGHT monster directly from your Deck.
Lightray Madoor
Level 6 LIGHT Spellcaster (1200 ATK / 3000 DEF): Special Summons itself from your hand if 3 or more of your LIGHT monsters are banished, and cannot be destroyed by battle once per turn.
Raiden, Hand of the Lightsworn
Level 4 LIGHT Warrior Tuner: mills 2 cards during your Main Phase and 2 during your End Phase to rapidly stock your GY with 4–5 LIGHT monsters for Lightray Daedalus and Lightray Diabolos.
Lumina, Lightsworn Summoner
Level 3 LIGHT Spellcaster: discards 1 LIGHT monster to revive Raiden from your GY, providing another LIGHT name and 2+ more mills.
Wulf, Lightsworn Beast
Level 4 LIGHT Beast-Warrior (2100 ATK): Special Summons itself whenever milled by Raiden, Minerva, Charge, or Solar Recharge, pairing with Raiden or Lightray Grepher to Xyz Summon Minerva!
Felis, Lightsworn Archer
Level 4 LIGHT Beast-Warrior Tuner: Special Summons itself when milled by Raiden or Minerva and tributes itself to pop a monster and mill 3 more LIGHT cards.
Charge of the Light Brigade
Mills 3 cards for cost and searches Raiden or Lumina—giving you 3 LIGHT monsters in the GY before you even Normal Summon!
Solar Recharge
Discards Wulf, Felis, or Lumina to draw 2 cards and mill 2 cards, fueling your GY with LIGHT names while digging for Lightray bosses.
